headword: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}

definitions.explanation: the process of planning and designing buildings and other structures

examples.japanese: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}を{学|まな}んでいる。
この{建物|たてもの}の{建築設計|けんちくせっけい}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{建築家|けんちくか}が{手|て}がけた。
examples.english: A famous architect handled the architectural design of this building.

examples.japanese: {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}{事務所|じむしょ}を{開|ひら}いて{独立|どくりつ}するのが{夢|ゆめ}だ。
examples.english: My dream is to open my own architectural design firm and become independent.

notes:
Composed of {建築|けんちく} (architecture; construction) + {設計|せっけい} (design; planning). Refers to the planning and design phase of building construction, encompassing floor plans, structural calculations, and aesthetic considerations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}{事務所|じむしょ}: architectural design firm
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}{図|ず}: architectural design drawings
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out architectural design
- {建築設計|けんちくせっけい}の{資格|しかく}: architectural design qualification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {設計|せっけい}: design; planning — broader term applicable to any type of design
- {建築|けんちく}: architecture; construction — the broader field encompassing both design and building
- {意匠設計|いしょうせっけい}: aesthetic/appearance design — focuses on the visual and functional aspects rather than structural
